messages:
Leila: FYI we got a quality alert from the fp8-v3 canary this morning. Overall small but concentrated on number-heavy, multi-entity prompts.
Tom: How small? absolute or relative? which eval slice?
Leila: ~0.9% absolute drop on our "extraction+numbers" slice over 15m. Model: gpt-small-v3, profile: fp8-v3.
Priya: Can you paste a couple of failing examples? curious if it's formatting or semantics.
Leila: Examples inline: 
- "Extract dates and amounts from the invoice table." -> missed one amount.
- "List all entities and their IDs from this paragraph." -> swapped two adjacent IDs.
Tom: ops-bot: what's the current canary state?
ops-bot: Canary rollout: fp8-v3 at 30% since 01:10 UTC. Auto-alert triggered at 01:23 UTC for slice extraction+numbers.
Jamal: Two hypotheses: (1) quantization pushing small heads sign-flips, (2) MLP scaling underflow on sparse numeric patterns. Could be per-head bias.
profiler-bot: Sampled activation norms show increased variance on heads 6 and 11 for affected requests (KL divergence vs baseline = 0.07).
Priya: We should run a targeted split test: mirror 2k matched requests to fp16 baseline and fp8-v3, collect per-example diffs. That'll tell us if it's systemic.
Tom: Agree. Also need a shorter path for ops: a canary policy that auto-holds and surfaces affected slices and a rollback button. Oncall folks won't dig into traces mid-incident.
Leila: Ops request: allow temporary high-rate shadowing for specific slices so we can get signal without broad rollout.
Jamal: Design idea: "quant-slice manifest" that teams can attach to rollouts. Fields: model, profile, named_slices (filters over runtime features), shadow_rate, thresholds, diag_flags.
Priya: Example manifest in thread: 
```
quant_slice_manifest:
  model: gpt-small-v3
  profile: fp8-v3
  slices:
    - name: extraction_numbers
      filter: "numeric_token_count > 2 and named_entity_count > 1"
  shadow_rate: 0.3
  thresholds:
    quality_delta_pct: 0.5
    min_samples: 200
  diag_flags: [per_head_norms, mlp_scale_hist]
```
Tom: Add a per-slice min-samples and an absolute quality floor (e.g., f1 >= 90%) so tiny slices don't trigger noisy rollbacks.
Jamal: Telemetry that would help: per-head mean/std, sign-flip counter, MLP pre-activation range, and a simple recompute-of-baseline metric (percent identical outputs). Keep them sampled at ~0.1% by default.
Leila: And show these signals in Console as a slice card with small sparkline + quick-sampling toggle.
Priya: For runtime safety, allow automatic ephemeral fallback: if a slice violates quality threshold for X minutes, route that slice to a higher-precision profile (fp8-v3 -> int8-mix or fp16-slow) for a grace period. This reduces blast radius.
Tom: Customers should be able to opt out of auto-fallback if they prefer strict latency guarantees. Add an opt-out flag in the manifest.
ops-bot: Note: fallback increases p95 by ~30-60ms in our internal tests.
Jamal: Cost/ops tradeoff: enabling per-head diagnostics at scale is expensive. Make diag_flags opt-in per-manifest and default to lightweight counters.
Priya: Also add an auto-slice discovery job: run nightly evals to propose slices (examples: long-entities, numeric-heavy, long-context with lists). Teams can accept or refine them.
Leila: Actionable items: 1) Priya - run targeted A/B for extraction_numbers slice (ETA 12h). 2) Tom - prototyping Console slice card + rollback CTA (ETA 3d). 3) Jamal - spec for quant-slice manifest + diagnostics flags (ETA 4d). 4) Ops - implement one-click high-shadow toggle (ETA 48h).
Tom: Also capture a canary policy template for SRE runbooks and include explicit thresholds and sample counts.
Jamal: I'll add a small library on the runtime side to evaluate slice predicates efficiently and attach per-request slice tags into traces.
Priya: If the A/B confirms systematic degradation, we should run a small calibration flow to test fp8-v3 with per-head rescale adjustments before rollback.
Leila: OK ops will pause further promotion at 30% pending the A/B. Will post results in this thread. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Canary promotion paused at 01:29 UTC (holding at 30%). Shadowing for extraction_numbers increased to 0.5 for 1h.
profiler-bot: Instrumentation note: enabling per-head histograms for the affected slice will add ~6% CPU overhead when active; recommend timeboxed collection.
Tom: Good convo. Let's treat this as a small product + runtime feature set: manifest, auto-slices, lightweight diag, UI surfacing, and opt-in auto-fallback. Keep the initial rollouts conservative.
Leila: Thanks all. I'll collect the A/B logs and tag the RFC once Jamal posts the spec.
